snippet.title: No Heroes Here 2 - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🎉 No Heroes Here 2 is now available for consoles and PC! 🏰💥

Play No Heroes Here 2 on Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch (also compatible with Switch 2), with a special launch discount!

Featuring 3D visuals, roguelike elements, and an even greater dose of co-op chaos, the game brings a refreshed and even more fun experience! Pick your favorite weapon and face waves of enemies across 30 different castles with up to 4 players, either online or in local co-op.

Plan, craft, and defend the castle with 16 unique characters across three kingdoms full of distinct mechanics: Noobland, Trollmeria, and Fungaria. You don’t need to be a hero to save the day. Just be ready to work as a team (and have a few laughs along the way)!

👉 Available now for PC and Consoles!
